acceptance_criteria: New `docs/specs/schema/manifest-0.1.json`: a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12, `"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"`) with a `title` and `description`, written in the canonical style (2-space indent, keys sorted), with: `type: object`, and `additionalProperties` not `false`, because readers keep unknown fields (FILE_FORMAT.md, Versioning); `format`: `const: "sltwx"`; `kind`: `enum: ["part", "assembly", "drawing"]`; `format_version`, `document_id` and `model_hash`: `type: string` with a `pattern` for major version 0 `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, a UUID, and `sha256:` plus 64 lowercase hex digits respectively, each matching what `read_manifest` accepts (a comment-free `description` per field says so); `units`: an object whose values are strings; `required`: exactly the fields `read_manifest` rejects when missing.
New `docs/specs/schema/README.md` (a few lines): what the folder holds, one file per `format_version` and document part, and that `read_manifest` is the reference.

New integration test `crates/swx-io/tests/manifest_schema.rs` (reads the schema by path from `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`): the schema parses as JSON and is byte-identical to its canonical form (`swx_io::to_canonical_json` or the crate's canonical writer); for every top-level key of `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/manifest-v0.1.json`: removing it makes `read_manifest` fail **if and only if** the key is in the schema's `required`; every key in `required` and every key of the golden manifest appears in `properties`; the `kind` enum equals the three kinds `read_manifest` accepts, and `format`'s `const` is `sltwx`.
All existing tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M4-05b: publish the JSON Schema for manifest.json, format v0.1
